skill.name: agentspace
skill.description: Share a user-selected local file or folder through Agentspace so others can view, comment on, or edit generated agent work in a browser.
skill.summary: Create live browser links for user-selected agent workspaces.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown examples or safety guardrails rather than direct shell execution. The substantive risk is that the skill runs a third-party CLI to upload user-selected local content and create browser-accessible share links.

remediation.issue: External CLI execution and package installation are part of the workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running ascli, npm, or npx, and show the exact path and permission mode first.

remediation.issue: The default share command grants edit permission.
remediation.suggestion: Default to view-only links unless the user clearly asks collaborators to edit the workspace.

remediation.issue: Shared links expose local content to an external hosted service.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to share secrets, private keys, credentials, or unrelated project folders.

content.user_title: Share Agent Workspaces with Live Links
content.value_statement: Agent outputs often stay trapped on one machine during review. Agentspace creates a browser link for a selected file or folder so teammates can view, comment, or edit.
actual_capabilities: Shares a user-selected local file or folder through the Agentspace CLI.
Returns the share URL printed by the CLI.
Supports edit links and view-only links when requested.
Uses npx or npm installation when ascli is not already available.
Documents command variants for local, npx, and monorepo workflows.
limitations: It sends selected content to the agentspace.so service.
Anonymous workspaces are temporary unless claimed by email.
It requires ascli, npm, or npx to run commands.
It does not verify whether shared files contain secrets.

use_cases.title: Review Generated Artifacts
use_cases.description: Share build logs, reports, screenshots, or prototypes from an agent run without packaging files manually.
use_cases.target_user: Developers using Claude, Codex, or Claude Code

use_cases.title: Hand Off Agent Work
use_cases.description: Give a teammate a live browser link to inspect or edit a selected workspace folder.

use_cases.title: Show Progress from Another Device
use_cases.description: Open an agent output folder in a browser while work continues on the original machine.

prompt_templates.title: Share a Folder
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with an explicit path.
prompt_templates.prompt: Share the folder I named with Agentspace and return the link.

prompt_templates.title: Create a View-Only Link
prompt_templates.prompt: Share this selected output folder as view-only and send me the Agentspace link.

prompt_templates.title: Confirm Before Sharing
prompt_templates.scenario: Review path and access level before upload.
prompt_templates.prompt: Before sharing, confirm the exact path and permission mode. Then create the Agentspace link.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Team Handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced handoff with artifacts and collaboration intent.
prompt_templates.prompt: Share the selected workspace for teammate review, use the requested permission, and summarize what the link contains.

output_examples.input: Share the generated report folder for review.
output_examples.output: The assistant confirms the folder path, creates an Agentspace share, and returns the live browser link.

output_examples.input: Give my teammate view-only access to the screenshots folder.
output_examples.output: The assistant uses view-only permission and returns a link that allows browsing without editing.

output_examples.input: Hand off this workspace so another engineer can edit it.
output_examples.output: The assistant creates an editable workspace link after confirming the intended path.

best_practices: Confirm the exact path before sharing any folder.
Use view-only links unless collaborators need edit access.
Review shared content for secrets before creating a link.
anti_patterns: Do not share the current directory when the user gave no path.
Do not return invented links or guessed workspace URLs.
Do not share project roots that may contain credentials or private files.

faq.question: What does this skill share?
faq.answer: It shares the file or folder path that the user explicitly selects.

faq.question: Does it require an account?
faq.answer: Anonymous workspaces can be created without signup, but claiming by email makes a workspace permanent.

faq.question: Can links be view-only?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill supports view-only links when the user asks for read-only access.

faq.question: Where does traffic go?
faq.answer: The skill documentation states that network traffic goes to agentspace.so.

faq.question: Does it work with Codex and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should users check before sharing?
faq.answer: Users should verify the path, permission level, and whether the content includes secrets.
